subject: Arbor Health: deployment isolation, SOC2 & questionnaire — next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Bennett <alex.bennett@arborhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Sep 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Arbor Health: deployment isolation, SOC2 & questionnaire — next steps

Alex — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we stay aligned: 

1) Current posture you mentioned
- SOC 2: in progress (security team estimate: audit window this fall)
- GDPR: controls live; data residency for PHI will be a US-only deployment for now
- HIPAA: covered via BAA for clinical data (you said legal will share the redline)

2) Redwood capabilities relevant to your asks
- Private/VPC deployment with network isolation and optional air-gapped images (we support periodic offline model updates via signed image bundles).
- KMS integrations for customer-managed keys (support HSM-backed flows on request).
- Evidence: we can provide SOC 2 interim reports and the usual network/ops evidence sets for questionnaires.

3) Immediate asks from Arbor (from the call)
- We’ll kick off your vendor security questionnaire (spreadsheet) and return the first pass within 5 business days.
- You requested a sample L3/L4 deployment diagram + a mapping of required ingress/egress ports and service endpoints.
- Schedule a 60-min SRE deep-dive with Karthik to go through firewall rules, tunneling, and maintenance windows.

Attachments: Arbor_VPC_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx (blank template) and redwood_deploy_diagram_template_v2.pdf (diagram template).

Proposed dates for the SRE deep-dive: Wed 9/8 10:00–11:00 PT or Thu 9/9 14:00–15:00 PT. Let me know which works and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — I’ll start populating the questionnaire and will loop Ben for the network-spec details.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
https://redwood.com
From: Alex Bennett <alex.bennett@arborhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: security.team@arborhealth.com
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2027 09:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Arbor Health: deployment isolation, SOC2 & questionnaire — next steps

Marissa — thanks for the concise recap. Confirming a few points from our side: 

- SOC 2: we are not the SOC 2 party here; our security/compliance reviewer meant Arbor's customer controls. For vendor acceptance we need Redwood's latest SOC 2 status and the interim control summary (if full attestation isn’t available).
- GDPR/HIPAA: Arbor will require the deployment to keep PHI in a US region and a signed BAA before any production traffic. Legal will circulate the BAA redline after lunch.
- Air-gap: we are highly interested in an air-gapped option for model serving in certain clinical sites — specifically, can you confirm whether Redwood supports model updates via physically transferred signed images and whether the support tooling requires outbound connectivity for licensing checks?

For the questionnaire: we received the template and will upload the filled XLSX to the Drive link you provided by end of day Friday (9/10).

SRE deep-dive: Wed 9/8 10:00 PT works for our team. Please include any prep docs (port list, expected maintenance windows).

Thanks,
Alex Bennett
Director, IT Security — Arbor Health Systems
alex.bennett@arborhealth.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Bennett <alex.bennett@arborhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, security.team@arborhealth.com
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2027 07:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Arbor Health: deployment isolation, SOC2 & questionnaire — next steps

Alex — got it, thanks for the clarifications. Short answers below and a few prep items attached.

SOC 2 status
- Redwood currently holds SOC 2 Type I and is in the final audit phase for Type II; we can provide the Type I report now and the control evidence bundle (interim) for the items you flagged (access reviews, incident runbooks, change management).

BAA/PHI
- We’ll sign a BAA. Please send your legal redline when ready; we have a pre-approved BAA template too (I can share).

Air-gapped updates
- Supported: we produce signed model/runtime images that can be transferred over secure media. The customer-managed air-gapped deployment does not require outbound licensing checks by default — we can enable a local license server you host, or optionally configure an outbound heartbeat if your ops team prefers remote licensing.

Prep for Wed 9/8 10:00 PT SRE deep-dive
- Attached: redwood_deploy_diagram_template_v2.pdf (please drop your current topology into the L3/L4 slots)
- Next deliverable from Redwood: a short port/list and service mapping (will send by Tue EOD) and a draft runbook for offline model updates.

I’ll send the calendar invite now (invite sent). Karthik will lead the SRE session; Ben will own the port/service mapping and will join as well.

Best,
Marissa
